title: The Judgment on the Children of Ammon
description: Ezekiel prophesies against the people of Ammon because they mocked the Lord. A polished sword is drawn to slaughter and devour; it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are sentenced to death while false prophets see empty visions and speak lies. The sword is returned to its sheath, for the Lord will judge Ammon in the place where they were created, in the land from which they came. He will pour out his fury, blow upon them with the fire of his wrath, and hand them over to ruthless men who devise destruction. They will become fuel for the fire; blood will flow throughout their land, and they will no longer be remembered.
